name: Conquistador de Waifus - World Starter Assets
notes: Original vector starter assets created for this project.
Terrain tile is a standalone diamond tile with transparent canvas outside the art.
Tree and prop atlas have transparent backgrounds and can be loaded as Phaser textures.
The ground-props atlas is a visual atlas; individual frame rectangles should be defined before using it as a Phaser spritesheet.
Additional terrain variants: dirt path, water surface, and grass/path corner.
